Attached please find a request from Salem Harbor Power Development Limited Partnership to amend a Chapter 91 license issued by the Energy Facilities Siting Board. The amendment would replace Salem Harbor Power’s obligation to construct an engineered concrete platform for use by mobile cranes and as a roll-on, roll-off facility on the harbor, with a payment of $1,700,000 to the City of Salem for the purpose of affecting improvements for water-dependent industrial uses within the Salem Harbor Designated Port Area. The Siting Board requests that any comments on Salem Harbor Power’s request be filed by Monday, December 2, 2024.
